Appreciate the clear asks and the draft MAP. I've sketched a sequencing plan attached (MAP_Consolidated_Timeline_20261218.xlsx) and summarized below as a single-page cadence to align expectations:

Proposed sequencing (high level):
1) Week of 2026-12-13 — Redwood legal to receive Aquila redlines; preliminary DPA comments within 3 business days
2) 2026-12-16 — Internal alignment on DPA redline risk items (data residency, logging, deletion SLAs)
3) 2026-12-20 — Final DPA + MSA negotiation window closes (aim for agreed redlines or documented fallbacks)
4) 2026-12-21 to 2027-01-05 — Procurement & finance finalize order form/PO (billing, payment terms, pilot caps)
5) 2027-01-07 — DocuSign packet sent for signature (MSA + DPA + order form can be bundled)
6) 2027-01-10 — Pilot provisioning (subject to signed order form and DPA confirmation)

Common blockers we see: late arrival of internal security evidence requests, custom SLA/indemnity asks, and procurement requiring PO numbers before legal completes redlines. To mitigate, we propose a "canary sign" option for the MSA with a DPA hold-back: pilot allowed under a narrow scope while DPA is finalized.

I've attached the timeline workbook and included a column for required evidence (SOC2 report link, cipher-suite summary, audit-log retention procedures). Laura / Marissa — can you review the proposed gating points and confirm whether bundling signatures (single DocuSign) is acceptable from legal/CS perspective?

If this looks good from Aquila, we can lock target signature dates and create a shared folder for redlines.
